description: This Java class 'ShadowPainter' provides methods for creating and drawing drop shadows around images and rectangles, including both rectangular and small shadows, with support for retina displays. It loads shadow graphics from resources and includes utility methods for rendering shadows in graphics contexts.

classes.name: ShadowPainter
classes.description: A utility class for creating and drawing drop shadows around images and rectangles, supporting different shadow sizes and retina display considerations.

methods.name: createDropShadow
methods.description: Creates a drop shadow for a given image with specified size, opacity, and color.

methods.name: createRectangularDropShadow
methods.description: Creates a new image with a rectangular drop shadow around the source image.

methods.name: createSmallRectangularDropShadow
methods.description: Creates a new image with a small rectangular drop shadow around the source image.

methods.name: drawRectangleShadow
methods.description: Draws a rectangular drop shadow around a specified rectangle in a BufferedImage.

methods.name: drawSmallRectangleShadow
methods.description: Draws a small rectangular drop shadow around a specified rectangle in a BufferedImage.
